text_visible: How to make LLM learn to reason efficiently?
Suppose you are asked to train an LLM to solve multi-step arithmetic (e.g. a+b×c-d÷e=?) with as few training steps as possible. How should you design your training distribution?

Let's say you are only allowed to change the training distribution of the numbers, which is the most basic "knowledge" of the arithmetic. One option is the standard uniform distribution, sampling every number with roughly equal probability. Another option is an asymmetric power-law distribution: rank all the numbers randomly, assigning probabilities according to power law, and sample accordingly. Which one will you choose?
Figure 1: Uniform distribution assigns nearly equal probability mass to each skill. Power-law distribution assigns higher probability mass to high-frequency skills and scarce long-tail skills.

这个问题正好是近两年一个比较热的研究方向，结论比较明确：两者相关但系统性地不一致，而且不一致的方向是可预测的——让模型口头输出（verbalize）的概率分布通常比它实际采样出来的答案频率分布更接近“真实/参考分布”，而实际采样分布会严重偏斜、模式坍缩。我完整读了三篇核心论文的原文，逐一汇报。
1. Meister, Guestrin & Hashimoto (NAACL 2025, "Benchmarking Distributional Alignment of LLMs", arXiv:2411.05403)
这篇是最直接回答你问题的。他们系统比较了三种“取出模型答案分布”的方式：(a)直接看首token的log概率（相当于从模型采样的理论分布）；(b)让模型一次吐出30个样本的序列（如ABBBAABDD...，行为上模拟采样器）；(c)让模型直接用JSON口头报出分布（如{A: 25%, B: 20%, C: 45%, D: 10%}）。

text_visible: (c)让模型直接用JSON口头报出分布（如{A: 25%, B: 20%, C: 45%, D: 10%}）。
他们先做了一个非常干净的玩具实验：在prompt里明确告诉模型“这枚硬币P(正)=p”，然后看三种方式还原出的p。结果是token log概率高度失准(uncalibrated)，即使真实分布就写在prompt里也会给出误导性的图景；而口头报分布和输出30个样本的序列这两种方式则没有这种失准。
在真实的民意分布模拟任务（OpinionQA、NYT图书偏好）上，排名是verbalize > sequence > log-prob
